description: Sample fallback policy for Vietnam, used when the gate cannot run gate_decision (deadline passed, store down, table error). Amounts in VND

rules.description: Fail closed: the watchlist check runs first and does not depend on anything that failed
Fail open: under 5,000,000 VND to a beneficiary the customer has paid before, with no remote access; monitoring looks at it again
Anything else is challenged: safer than refusing, and the customer can still complete the payment
